title: Work IQ: invoke custom agents and agents that call third-party tools
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, documented controls and consumption licensing are supported, and its feature-specific gaps remain appropriately narrow. The agent-block API should additionally warn that Microsoft does not support production use of beta APIs.
